decision_conditions: The proposed dormer, by reason of its size, siting, and design, would appear bulky and incongruous. It would represent an overly dominant and visually intrusive form of roof addition that is out of keeping with the character of the host property and detrimental to the appearance and character of the Grange Park Conservation Area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3, D4, and HC1 of the London Plan (2021); Policies CP30 and CP31 of the Core Strategy (2010); Policies DMD13, DMD37, and DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014); the National Planning Policy Framework (2025); and the guidance contained within the Grange Park Conservation Area Character Appraisal.

Insufficient information has been provided regarding the proposed replacement door and windows, including their detailed design, materials, and appearance. In the absence of this information, the local planning authority is unable to fully assess the impact of these elements on the character and appearance of the host property and the Grange Park Conservation Area. The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3, D4, and HC1 of the London Plan (2021); Policies CP30 and CP31 of the Core Strategy (2010); Policies DMD8, DMD13, DMD37, and DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014); the National Planning Policy Framework (2025); and the guidance contained within the Grange Park Conservation Area Character Appraisal.

The proposed rooflight would represent an incongruous and alien addition to the roofscape, due to its siting, design and size, which is out of character with the age and style of the existing historic building thereby failing to preserve and enhance the character and appearance of the Grange Park Conservation Area.  The proposal is therefore contrary to Policies D3, D4, and HC1 of the London Plan (2021); Policies CP30 and CP31 of the Core Strategy (2010); Policies DMD13, DMD37, and DMD44 of the Development Management Document (2014); the National Planning Policy Framework (2024); and the guidance contained within the Grange Park Conservation Area Character Appraisal.
description: Single storey rear extension, rear dormer with side rooflight and external alterations involving new replacement door and windows.
